THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
RUNWAY
088
STUDY 139
Navy Long Coat with Burgundy Cuffs
Rights check
Source: 25034.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, wavy blonde hair
walks a pale blue runway in a long navy wool coat with
notched lapels, burgundy patent leather cuffs, and
burgundy piping. Navy wide-leg trousers, a high navy
velvet collar, and navy gloves complete the look. She
carries a burgundy quilted shoulder bag with silver
chain. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, even
runway light. Palette of navy, burgundy, and pale blue.
Tailored and elegant, in the style of a fall runway show.
Tailored, elegant, bold
WORKING NOTES
- The burgundy cuffs and piping are the defining details.
- Add 'mid-stride' to capture the walk.
